name: Owl Practice
short_description: Canadian-built mental health EHR for therapists, psychologists, and counselors with integrated billing, scheduling, notes, and telehealth.
long_description: Owl Practice is a cloud-based practice management and clinical documentation platform built specifically for the Canadian mental health market. Founded around 2014 in Toronto, Ontario by Andrew Sloss, Owl Practice serves therapists, psychologists, counselors, and social workers across Canada. The platform handles Canadian-specific workflows including HST/GST tax calculations, direct billing to Canadian insurance providers, provincial regulatory compliance, and Canadian privacy frameworks (PIPEDA and provincial equivalents). Features include scheduling with online booking, clinical documentation, HIPAA-compliant telehealth, billing with direct insurance submission, and a client portal. Owl's newest feature, Smart Notes, is a built-in AI note-taker that helps clinicians turn sessions into documentation quickly. The platform is positioned as a privacy-first solution with Canadian data residency and end-to-end encryption.
one_liner: The mental health EHR built in Canada, for Canadian clinicians.
best_for: Solo practitioners needing affordable Canadian EHR
Practices wanting Canadian insurance direct billing
Clinicians prioritizing Canadian data residency and privacy
not_for: US practices with complex American insurance billing
Addiction treatment centers or specialized programs

pricing.notes: Plans for students, part-time therapists, 2 solo pricing levels, and group plans. Administrative staff: no charge. Supervisor logins: free. No setup fees, no onboarding fees. Canadian Association discounts available. Refer a Friend: $100 off for referrals.

compliance.notes: Canadian data residency, PIPEDA and provincial privacy law compliance, end-to-end encryption

faqs.q: How much does Owl Practice cost?
faqs.a: Owl Practice pricing ranges from $25-$49/provider/month. Plans are tailored for students, part-time therapists, solo practitioners, and groups. Admin staff and supervisor logins are free. No setup or onboarding fees.

faqs.q: Is Owl Practice only for Canadian practices?
faqs.a: Owl Practice is built specifically for the Canadian market with Canadian billing, tax calculations, and privacy compliance (PIPEDA, PHIPA). US and international practices may find better-suited alternatives.

faqs.q: Does Owl Practice have AI features?
faqs.a: Yes, Owl Practice has Smart Notes, a built-in AI note-taker that helps clinicians turn sessions into documentation quickly. This is their newest feature for clinical documentation.
Yes, Owl Practice is HIPAA compliant with BAA available. It's also compliant with Canadian privacy laws including PIPEDA and PHIPA, with Canadian data residency.
